Create TWO genuine transparent RGBA basket sprites in one horizontal row, requested2048x1024, equal square cells. They are original 灵葫大作战 collectible basket world phases13 LEFT and14 RIGHT. Both required: basket FRONT with boy at viewer-LEFT and his nose/face directed unambiguously toward VIEWER-LEFT, same as source13/14 and neighbouring corrected12. Crimson scroll in FRONT RIGHT leaning up-right; golden double gourd behind centre, palejade/ivory fan behind right. Same four contents only, golden shallow woven bamboo oval basket with jade cloud medallion centred on front. No source penguin/blackwhite licensed face/redscarf/beak.
LEFT phase13: taller UPRIGHT tiny boy rising above rim with short torso visible, source full visible envelope width:height38:36=1.056 (about650wide615high). RIGHT phase14: boy settles LOWER with most body hidden by rim, same left-facing side view; source envelope37:33=1.121 (about650wide580high). Scroll prominent to front-right, fan/gourd behind. Difference from13 must be clear downward seated posture, not just whole sprite translated. Do not shift whole-object offsets, export keeps raw offsets separately.

Keep basket craft/number of objects/face identity/relative side relationships coherent with inputs2/3, fine rounded hand-painted jade/ivory/warmgold, not plastic3D. Exactly one whole sprite centred in each1024square with >=90px genuine clear alpha margin. No cells crossing. Outside and gaps fully transparent; no brown background glow/fog/cast shadow/ground/halo, no labels/text/numbers/UI/grid, no head wearer under basket. Highest host-provided quality target. Never nonuniform stretch or mirror.
